description: This file defines custom SQL dialect classes for Firebolt within the sqlglot library, including parser and generator customizations, and support for an older version of the dialect.

classes.name: Firebolt
classes.description: A custom SQL dialect class for Firebolt, including a nested Parser and Generator class for handling Firebolt-specific syntax and precedence rules.

classes.name: FireboltOld
classes.description: A dialect class for an older version of Firebolt, with modifications such as treating UNNEST as an operator and custom join parsing.

methods.name: _negate_range
methods.description: Wraps an expression in parentheses with a NOT expression to handle Firebolt's precedence rules.

methods.name: not_sql
methods.description: Generates SQL for negated expressions, parenthesizing NOT expressions when they involve IN clauses.

methods.name: _parse_join
methods.description: Parses JOIN expressions, including handling of UNNEST in the old dialect.

methods.name: _parse_unnest
methods.description: Parses UNNEST expressions, supporting expressions with optional aliasing.

methods.name: join_sql
methods.description: Generates SQL for JOIN expressions, with special handling for UNNEST and other join components.
